4f_iris_radius.objective_definition: RMSE between centered azimuthally averaged, plane-normalized radial intensity profiles over z

effective_axicon_lateral_displacement.objective_definition: RMSE of plane-normalized intensity-centroid trajectory over z

identifiability_warning: These are scalar-route hypothesis-screening values. The camera optical axis versus stage z, input Gaussian radius, and high-angle vector response are not calibrated. A selected boundary or a near-equal competing beam-displacement loss prevents a hardware adjustment claim.
